author: Creative Leads Community
title: Indie game team hiring 3D Character Artist & Animator
content:
A small independent game development team is looking for a 👤 3D Character Artist & Animator (Remote - US Preferred/Applicants Worldwide Considered)

A freelance contract for an artist to create 3D characters and creatures for a co-op game. Responsibilities include modeling, UV unwrapping, texturing, rigging and creating expressive gameplay animations in Blender. Requires proficiency in Blender and texturing, with organized source files and exports. Unity import experience is a bonus. Open to students, self-taught and early-career artists. Compensation is $15 USD/hour for up to 8 hours per week, starting with a 30-day paid contract. Remote applicants worldwide may be considered depending on time-zone overlap and payment arrangements, with US-based applicants preferred.
